description: AuthHist - All With History is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Trucking and Motorcoaches", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation. Dataset Records showing the history of each authority granted to a carrier/broker/freight forwarder, along with the dates of the original authority action (e.g., “granted”) and the final authority action (e.g., “revoked”). The dataset contains the DOT number and docket number of the entity that holds or held the authority. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Trucking and Motorcoaches". It has 9 columns, among them DISP_SERVED_DATE, DISP_DECIDED_DATE, DISP_ACTION_DESC, SUB_NUMBER, DOT_NUMBER, OP_AUTH_TYPE. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
